sent_to_review.title: Carbon Capture, Utilization and Storage Gordon Research Conference
sent_to_review.summary: The 2027 Gordon Research Conference on Carbon Capture, Utilization and Storage, subtitled "Scientific Foundations for the Carbon Management Infrastructure of the 21st Century", takes place 30 May to 4 June 2027 at Les Diablerets, Switzerland. Sessions include advances in CO₂ utilization, transport and storage science, systems science for carbon management, lessons from deployment, and policy and societal dimensions of scaling. Applications close on 2 May 2027; the detailed programme is due by 30 January 2027.
sent_to_review.why_it_matters: A small, research-focused meeting with dedicated sessions on CO₂ transport and systems-level integration of capture, transport and storage, a natural venue for presenting CCS network-optimisation work.

related.title: 2027 Carbon Capture, Utilization and Storage (GRS) Seminar
related.reason: Companion early-career seminar (29–30 May 2027) held just before the conference; oral-talk abstracts are due 21 February 2027.

related.title: Europe needs 65-strong CO2 shipping fleet and 33 ports to store carbon at scale, Xodus report finds
related.reason: Recent system-level estimate of Europe's CO₂ pipeline/ship split, fleet and port needs to 2050: the kind of infrastructure question the conference's systems sessions address.

related.title: International Carbon Dioxide Flows
related.reason: IEAGHG study of the drivers, size and direction of cross-border CO₂ flows to 2035 and 2050, relevant background for transport and systems research.

sent_to_review.title: Summer School 2027
sent_to_review.summary: DTU Offshore's 2027 Summer School on subsurface storage runs 7–10 September 2027 at DTU Lyngby Campus, Denmark. The four-day programme includes a track on CO₂ storage and carbon management (regulation, site characterisation, well integrity, monitoring and risk), alongside underground hydrogen and gas storage, geothermal, digitalisation and AI, and technical excursions. Registration is open via the page; no deadline is stated.
sent_to_review.why_it_matters: A Danish course on the storage end of the chain, including storage regulation and risk, useful for researchers who model storage-site capacity and constraints in Nordic CCS networks.

related.title: 12th Delft Summer School
related.reason: Comparable European summer school on subsurface energy storage, including CCS in aquifers and depleted fields and underground hydrogen storage.
